servo_mount_note: HBL388 manufacturer drawing identifies M3 at the shaft centre and R2 open mounting-ear slots; use M3 through-bolts/captive DIN934 nuts, not assumed tapped ear holes or housing screws.

bearings.product: 6200RS (user stock; brand and seal count not supplied)
bearings.source_method: SKF generated product sheet distributed by Industrial-GP; numerical text decoded from embedded Unicode CMap, not guessed from a model envelope
bearings.coordinate_frame: Bearing-local axial coordinate: bore axis +Z, entrance face at Z=0; assembly rigid transforms recorded in manifest.json
bearings.tolerances: Catalogue dimensions are nominal. Approximate ring shoulders are not tolerances; actual user-bearing brand, shoulders, chamfers, seals and internal clearance remain unmeasured.
bearings.verification_status: 10x30x9 catalogue envelope and SKF reference abutments verified from extracted source text; compatibility of user's individual bearings requires physical trial
bearings.seal_note: RS/2RS suffixes must not be silently equated. Geometry uses the common 6200 envelope; bearing/seal friction and face clearance require physical acceptance.

limitations: Sourced catalogue envelopes and CAD verification only. No real fastener, tool, bearing, insert or printed-part acceptance test. SKF abutments are a named reference, not proof of an unknown-brand 6200RS face/seal geometry. Historical SKF_61800 files, if present, are retained references and are not current BOM items.
